item.title: vmware-workstation: 17.6.4 -> 25H2u1
item.description:
Things done

Update VMware Workstation to 25H2u1, the latest version available.

ChangeLog

It appears as though VMware upgraded their shipped libxml2 without recompiling a few of their libraries against it. Using patchelf to replace libxml2 in these libraries with the upgraded version works. This was testing by starting the app to create and start a VM.
